units.source_text: “我失去父母的时候，还不到二十岁。

en.t: When I lost my parents, I was not yet twenty.

units.source_text: 记得妻子对你说过，我父母死于同一种疾病，

en.t: I remember that my wife told you my parents died of the same illness,

units.source_text: 而且几乎是前后脚去世的（妻子说你当时非常惊讶），

en.t: and that they died almost one right after the other (my wife said you were very surprised at the time),

units.source_text: 实际上父亲得的是伤寒，

en.t: but in fact my father had typhoid fever,

units.source_text: 传染给了看护他的母亲。

en.t: and it was passed on to my mother, who was nursing him.
I was my parents' only child,

units.source_text: 由于家境优裕，我从小到大可说是一帆风顺。

en.t: and because my family was well-off, my life could be called smooth sailing from childhood onward.

units.source_text: 回顾往昔，如果父母没有死，

en.t: Looking back, if my parents had not died,
or if even one of them had still been alive,

units.source_text: 那么，我自然会将那优越的心态保持到现在的。

en.t: then I would naturally have kept that relaxed, privileged state of mind to this day.
